import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
import pytest

class Test_Embedded_Controller(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_meet_commanded_pressure(self):
        # Test that the controller meets commanded pressure during the pressure fall phase
        # within an overshoot of 0.8*PEEP-1 cmH2O
        commanded_pressure = 20  # cmH2O
        peep = 25  # cmH2O
        overshoot = 0.8 * peep - 1  # cmH2O
        self.assertLessEqual(commanded_pressure, overshoot)

    def test_meet_commanded_peep(self):
        # Test that the controller meets commanded PEEP within +-1 H2O + 10%
        commanded_peep = 20  # cmH2O
        self.assertLessEqual(commanded_peep, 22)  # 20 + 10% of 20
        self.assertGreaterEqual(commanded_peep, 18)  # 20 - 10% of 20

    def test_target_fio2(self):
        # Test that the controller achieves target FiO2 value within 0.05
        target_fio2 = 0.5
        self.assertLessEqual(target_fio2, 0.55)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(target_fio2, 0.45)

    def test_fio2_reporting(self):
        # Test that the controller reports FiO2 as measured prior to patient inhale limb
        fio2 = 0.5
        self.assertEqual(fio2, 0.5)

    def test_air_density(self):
        # Test that the controller achieves commanded values under different air conditions
        # affecting air density, such as temperature, altitude and humidity
        temperature = 25  # Celsius
        altitude = 1000  # meters
        humidity = 60  # percentage
